title: Tall whites posing as Charlie Hall and his wife to visit Livermore
summary: Charles Hall tells of Tall whites posing as Charlie Hall and his wife to visit Livermore, about 1960s at Lawrence Livermore Laboratory, California, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

plain: Charles Hall, a man who says he lived alongside tall, pale beings he calls the Tall Whites in the Nevada desert in the 1960s, says some of them passed themselves off as humans. He told podcast host Jesse Michels in 2025 that one of them went by his own name, Charlie Hall, and a female one he names Pamela pretended to be that Charlie Hall's wife, so the two of them could get into places like the Lawrence Livermore Laboratory, a US government science lab in California, and talk with the scientists. That would mean these beings were quietly mixing with top American researchers.
